stories.title: Saskatchewan police watchdog investigating death of 24-year-old man during RCMP response
stories.summary: The investigation will examine the conduct of police and the circumstances surrounding the man's death.

stories.title: Station 20 West appeals Saskatoon order to dismantle encampment
stories.summary: Station 20 West has appealed the City of Saskatoon's order to clean up an encampment on its property by the end of this month, according to its director.

stories.title: Tentative deal reached with Regina transit workers after one-day lockout
stories.summary: A news release from the city says transit service will not be restored in time for the Tuesday morning commute, but is expected to be up and running by Tuesday afternoon.

stories.title: Child killed in crash involving SUV, semi-truck on Regina Bypass
stories.summary: RCMP in Saskatchewan say a young child has died after a two-vehicle collision involving an SUV and a semi-truck.

stories.title: ‘Waste to opportunity’: Saskatchewan government to expand bioenergy in north
stories.summary: Premier Scott Moe said Friday's announcement will support the power grid and forestry sector to prepare both for the future demands they are projected to see.

stories.title: Historic guns locked away as RCMP centre set to become next national museum
stories.summary: At the RCMP Heritage Centre in Regina, which is set to become Canada's next national museum, one display case is glaringly empty.

stories.title: Saskatchewan recovery centre, accused of falsifying records, to be investigated by auditor
stories.summary: NDP health critic Meara Conway says the leaked records make it appear the EHN Willowview Recovery Centre could be falsifying the documents, which she says would be illegal.

stories.title: Alouettes place eight players on All-CFL team
stories.summary: Montreal Alouettes quarterback Davis Alexander and receivers Tyson Philpot and Tyler Snead earned All-CFL all-star honours Thursday.

stories.title: Saskatoon potash company signs lease for new U.S. terminal, bypassing B.C.
stories.summary: The company -- based in Saskatoon -- says Longview emerged as its preferred site based on factors including location, logistics and capacity.

stories.title: A ‘long road’ lies ahead for Regina boy, 4, after alleged medical malpractice
stories.summary: The family of a Regina boy, 4, who needs a small intestine transplant alleges that it is the result of medical malpractice stemming from his appendicitis treatment in September.
